weather_report:
As the afternoon unfolds in Boston, the sun shines generously upon the city, casting a warm glow on the bustling streets teeming with life. The temperature climbs to a comfortable high, flirting with 81 degrees, as a gentle southwest breeze whispers through the trees—a subtle promise of an inviting evening ahead. The richness of the day invites one to venture outdoors, whether it's a leisurely stroll along the Charles River or perhaps an afternoon spent sipping coffee at a nearby café, soaking in the vibrant pulse of the city.

As twilight approaches, the sky will transition into a canvas of soft hues, with a few isolated rain showers anticipated shortly, from 7 to 8 PM, though they seem more like fleeting whispers than any significant disruption. With a low settling around 60 degrees, light layers will prove beneficial against the evening’s cool embrace. It’s a time to relish the remnants of daylight, perhaps exploring a local art exhibit or enjoying a serene moment in one of Boston’s picturesque parks. For those caught in the enchantment of the city—there is much to savor before night falls, making the most of this splendid day.
